name: Nyann
description: Nyann is a Claude Code plugin that sets up and maintains project governance: git workflow, hooks, branching, commits, releases, CI, docs routing, and health monitoring. From first init through every PR after.
longDescription:
Ships **30 skills**, **30 commands** and **2 hooks**.

- **Skills** (30): `add-team-source` (Register a git URL as a team-profile source so nyann can periodically sync and expose its profiles under…), `bootstrap-project` (Bootstrap a fresh or existing repo with nyann), `check-prereqs` (Survey the machine and report which nyann features are usable right now), `cleanup-branches` (Prune local branches whose work is already merged into the base), `commit` (Generate a Conventional Commits message from the staged diff and create the commit after user confirmation), `diagnose` (Bundle a redacted, support-grade snapshot of the current nyann state for inclusion in a bug report or support…), `doctor` (Run a read-only hygiene + documentation audit on the current repo), `explain-state` (Summarize what nyann currently sees in this repo: stack detection, active profile, branching strategy, hook status, CLAUDE.md, and…), and 22 more
- **Commands** (30): `add-team-source` (Register a team-profile git source in ~/.claude/nyann/config.json), `bootstrap` (Explicit entry point for nyann's bootstrap flow), `branch` (Create a strategy-compliant git branch), `check-prereqs` (Survey the machine and report which nyann features are usable right now), `cleanup-branches` (Prune local branches whose work is already merged into the base), `commit` (Generate a Conventional Commits message from the staged diff and commit after confirmation), `diagnose` (Bundle a redacted support-grade snapshot of the current nyann state (state + drift + hooks + config +…), `doctor` (Run nyann's read-only hygiene + documentation audit on the current repo), and 22 more
- **Hooks** (2): `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`

Installs with `claude plugin install nyann@claude-community` from `thettwe/nyann`.
